aiResearchSummary.text: Code42 is focused on developing systems for data loss protection and recovery by monitoring file system element transfers and detecting data exfiltration through applications. Their research includes forensic file services that adjust data according to database schemas and user behavior analytics to identify insider threats. They also work on detecting suspicious file activity and delivering security content based on user personas. These efforts aim to enhance data visibility and protection across networked environments.
